items.title: Live: Equipment failure to blame for Geelong oil refinery fire, firefighters say
items.description: Authorities are fighting a fire engulfing the Geelong Viva Enery oil refinery, one of two major refineries in the country. Follow live.

items.title: Refinery blaze may impact Australia's petrol production 'for some time'
items.description: Energy Minister Chris Bowen says the fire in Geelong appears to be an accident at this stage and there are no suspicious circumstances.

items.title: Live: Iranian-flagged ship tries to evade US blockade as Pakistan mediators arrive in Tehran
items.description: The US president has said a deal with Iran is "preferable" and to expect an "amazing two days" ahead. Follow live.

items.title: Defence spending to climb by $53 billion as 'international norms' erode
items.description: Australia's defence spending will climb by $53 billion over the next decade amid what the federal government says are "intensifying" global risks.

items.title: Breaking: Unemployment rate remains at 4.3pc
items.description: Australia's unemployment rate remained at 4.3 per cent in March, the same as February, in seasonally adjusted terms.

items.title: Video shows father and son illegally scuttling boat off NSW South Coast
items.description: The two fishermen were fined $15,000 for towing their vessel out to sea and illegally scuttling in a historic judgement.

items.title: New data reveals age group spending up big
items.description: Australians spent more in March as the outbreak of the Iran war drove up petrol prices. Older Australians increased their spending at the fastest pace, CBA data shows.

items.title: Former US Marines pilot Dan Duggan loses bid to avoid extradition from Australia
items.description: Former United States Marine Corp pilot Dan Duggan’s Federal Court bid to avoid extradition from Australia is dismissed.

items.title: Why Australia turned to tiny nation to secure critical fertiliser supplies
items.description: The Middle East conflict has disrupted the flow of Australia's imports of the fertiliser urea. Facing the potential threat of reduced crop yields, Anthony Albanese looked to Australia's neighbours.

items.title: Australia's rarest reptile found after being considered extinct
items.description: Not found anywhere else on Earth, a skink considered functionally extinct has been found in a national park in far west NSW.

items.title: Live: Unemployment remains at 4.3pc, Viva Energy in trading halt after fire
items.description: Viva Energy is in a trading halt after a fire at its Geelong oil refinery. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Breaking: Uncovered ballots prompt new count in key SA seat won by One Nation
items.description: The Electoral Commission of South Australia uncovers ballot papers that were not counted in the seat of Narungga on the state's Yorke Peninsula.

items.title: 'Historic' pay rise for NSW nurses, midwives but 'more work to be done'
items.description: Registered nurses will receive a "one-off reset" of a 10 per cent pay rise in the first year, backdated to July 1, 2025, and a 3 per cent pay rise the following two years.

items.title: Kerr scores landmark goal as Matildas win FIFA Series
items.description: Sam Kerr's 75th international goal has helped the Matildas to a surprisingly tough, controversial 2-0 victory over Kenya in the FIFA Series final.

items.title: Rebel Wilson's directorial debut hits Aus cinemas amid legal dispute
items.description: Plus a powerful look Palestinian life through multiple generations and a buzzy Japanese video game adaptation makes it to Australian shores.

items.title: Quiz: Can you tell the difference between The Pitt and ER?
items.description: Ahead of The Pitt season finale dropping this week, can you pick the difference between it and its hospital drama ancestor ER?

items.title: Back Roads: How this tiny town welcomed a 70-piece orchestra
items.description: The Sydney Youth Orchestras travelled to this tiny town to help inspire the local kids, but when they left, they were the ones who felt changed.

items.title: As the dust settles on Gina Rinehart's huge court case, the reviews are in
items.description: Gina Rinehart and her company, Hancock Prospecting, are the "clear winners" of what prominent Perth industry commentator Tim Treadgold said was the "big daddy" of legal battles.

items.title: Creators of fuel dashboard quoted by News Corp have links to Liberals
items.description: An ABC NEWS Verify investigation raises questions about popular independent fuel security dashboards that have emerged online, including one whose creators are linked to the Liberal Party.

items.title: Ukraine looking to 'capitalise' on new momentum against Russia
items.description: Western officials and analysts say Ukrainian forces have disrupted Russia's planned spring offensive and managed to retake territory.

items.title: Breaking: Tasmanian government tries to avert parliamentary defeat of greyhound racing ban
items.description: The Tasmanian government is deferring debate on its bill to ban greyhound racing, in the hopes of eventually winning over enough upper house members for it to pass.

items.title: Pilot in critical condition after light plane crashes in paddock
items.description: A man who was trapped in a lightweight aircraft that crashed in the NSW Southern Highlands has been taken to hospital in a critical condition.

items.title: Major upgrades planned for 200-hectare site once used as TV, film backdrop
items.description: Australian-based global tour operator Intrepid has announced a multi-million-dollar investment in Central Australia's Ooraminna Homestead, 30 kilometres south of Alice Springs.

items.title: Supermarkets stalling over pressure to lift milk prices
items.description: Supermarket milk price rises linked to the war in Iran are predicted in the coming months as hundreds of dairy farmers battling increasing costs receive more for their product.

items.title: Ticketmaster and Live Nation hold 'harmful' anticompetitive monopoly, US jury finds
items.description: A New York jury finds concert giant Live Nation and its Ticketmaster subsidiary have a harmful monopoly over big concert venues.
